definitions.explanation: Having the darkest color, the opposite of white.

examples.japanese: {黒|くろ}い⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{黒|くろ}く⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{黒|くろ}い⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I wear a black suit to go to work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{黒|くろ}く⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれいに→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦{見|み}えます→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: When night falls, it gets dark outside. You can see the stars clearly.

notes:
{黒|くろ}い is an い-adjective meaning black - the darkest color.

FORMS:
- Adjective: {黒|くろ}い (black)
- Noun: {黒|くろ} (black, the color black)
- Adverb: {黒|くろ}く ({黒|くろ}くなる - to become dark)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黒|くろ}い{髪|かみ}: black hair
- {黒|くろ}い{目|め}: dark eyes
- {黒|くろ}い{服|ふく}: black clothes
- {黒|くろ}い{猫|ねこ}: black cat

RELATED COLORS:
- {白|しろ}い: white (opposite)
- {赤|あか}い: red
- {青|あお}い: blue

NOTE:
{黒|くろ} can also have figurative meanings like "guilty" ({黒|くろ}だ - guilty) in contrast to {白|しろ} (innocent).
